```json
{"sql":"WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT s.campaign_id AS campaign_id, s.lead_id AS lead_id, s.message_id AS message_id
  FROM sends s
  JOIN leads l
    ON l.company_id = s.company_id
   AND l.id = s.lead_id
   AND l.opted_out = 0
  WHERE s.company_id = :company_id
),
delivered AS (
  SELECT e.campaign_id AS campaign_id, e.lead_id AS lead_id, r.occurred_at AS occurred_at
  FROM eligible e
  JOIN receipts r
    ON r.company_id = :company_id
   AND r.message_id = e.message_id
   AND r.status IN ('delivered','read')
),
att AS (
  SELECT campaign_id, COUNT(DISTINCT lead_id) AS n FROM eligible GROUP BY campaign_id
),
del AS (
  SELECT campaign_id, COUNT(DISTINCT lead_id) AS n, MAX(occurred_at) AS last_at FROM delivered GROUP BY campaign_id
)
SELECT c.id AS campaign_id,
       COALESCE(att.n, 0) AS attempted_leads,
       COALESCE(del.n, 0) AS delivered_leads,
       del.last_at AS last_delivery_at
FROM campaigns c
LEFT JOIN att ON att.campaign_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN del ON del.campaign_id = c.id
WHERE c.company_id = :company_id
ORDER BY c.id"}
```
